what: Postbump keeps inline flush_logs_pre while parity tests target the bash postbump subcommand alone
scenario_or_breakage: The plan preserves flush_logs_pre inside finalize.postbump and requires field-for-field parity against bash implement-finalize postbump, but bash postbump never flushes logs (LOG_WRITE_STATUS stays skipped; refresh-run-logs.sh runs in ship-pr.sh first). Side-by-side parity cases will diverge on flush side effects and log-refresh failure statuses.
suggested_fix: Match bash layering: run the pre-push refresh from ship.py before postbump (like refresh-run-logs.sh), drop flush from finalize.postbump, emit LOG_WRITE_STATUS=skipped on the postbump result, or document an explicit parity boundary and exclude flush from postbump subprocess cases.
